Theorem: Aut(lambda) acts on Pi_k preserving each fibre F_{lambda nu}={pi : lambda^pi = nu} and preserving mu(hat0,pi) (block sizes are preserved), so by orbit-stabiliser (M^{-1})_{lambda nu} = sum over Aut(lambda)-orbits O in F of mu_O/|Stab(O)|, whence den divides lcm_O(|Stab(O)|/gcd(|Stab(O)|,mu_O)).
